_icons.{escape}: Escape token (flipped side of Locked Escape)
_icons.{supply-small}: small Supply token placed on a player aid
_icons._typeIcon: All Objective Item cards carry a crosshair/target type icon in the top-right corner; most also show their own token icon beside it
_icons._involvedAction: Black oval with three dots at the bottom of the card = Involved Action
_icons._supply: Supply icon (stacked cubes) with a number or infinity = number of uses

cards.name: Battery
cards.text:
To install in the Truck, bring to the {truck} (Truck) token. Only 1 Part may be installed per round (not 1 Part per Investigator)
See the Fix The Truck player aid for more details

cards.name: Frayed Ropes
cards.text:
The Butcher must place a {shadow-facedown} (face-down Shadow) token within 3 spaces of himself on the main board
See the Banish The Butcher player aid for more details

cards.name: Fuse
cards.text:
Bring to the {escape-locked} (Locked Escape) token to flip the token to the {escape} (Escape) side
See the Power The Gate player aid for more details

cards.name: Lockbox
cards.text:
To cut open the Lockbox, bring to the {saw} (Saw) token. You may only use the Saw once per round (not once per Investigator)
See the Power The Gate player aid for more details

cards.name: Repair Kit
cards.text:
To repair the Truck, bring to the {truck} (Truck) token. Only 1 Part may be installed per round (not 1 Part per Investigator)
See the Fix The Truck player aid for more details

cards.name: The Hook
cards.text:
Once the {burning-grave-facedown} (face-down Burning) token is removed, you may choose an adjacent space. If The Butcher is on this space, you kill him and win the game. This card may only be used once per round (not once per Investigator)
See the Banish The Butcher player aid for more details

cards.name: Spark Plugs
cards.text:
To install in the Truck, bring to the {truck} (Truck) token. Only 1 Part may be installed per round (not 1 Part per Investigator)
See the Fix The Truck player aid for more details
cards.notes: Card name is plural 'Spark Plugs'; the matching board token is named 'Spark Plug' on the Sawmill/Garage escape cards

cards.name: Ritual Knife
cards.text:
When on the {altar} (Altar) token, flip one of your {wound-facedown} face-up or give yourself a {wound-facedown} to place 1 {supply-small} token on the Banish The Cult player aid. This card may only be used once per round (not once per Investigator)
See the Banish The Cult player aid for more details

cards.name: Rope Circle
cards.text:
All surviving Investigators must be in a single group, adjacent to at least 1 other Investigator, and at least 1 must be adjacent to the {altar} (Altar) token
When there are 3 {supply-small} tokens on the Banish The Cult player aid, you may banish The Cult and win the game
See the Banish The Cult player aid for more details

cards.name: Flare Gun
cards.text:
With an {ammo} (Ammo) token in your inventory, bring to the {escape-locked} (Locked Escape) token to signal for help
See the Fire The Flare player aid for more details

cards.name: Ammo
cards.text:
One Investigator must bring an {ammo} (Ammo) token and the Flare Gun to the {escape-locked} (Locked Escape) token
See the Fire The Flare player aid for more details

cards.name: Angle Grinder
cards.text:
With a {ride-parts} (Ride Parts) token in your inventory, bring to the {escape-locked} (Locked Escape) token to begin cutting open the lock
See the Service Tunnels player aid for more details

cards.name: Ride Parts
cards.text:
One Investigator must bring a {ride-parts} (Ride Parts) token and the Angle Grinder to the {escape-locked} (Locked Escape) token
See the Service Tunnels player aid for more details
